adversarial_framing_findings: Adversarial/non-neutral framing of the ongoing 2026 Iran conflict and Houthi strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure clearly exists (Al Jazeera 'US-Israel war on Iran' framing; Middle East Eye Qatar-linked framing), but every datable framing article verified to Aug 7-14 2026 -- none published within the 22-23 Aug coverage window.
notes: All 13 themed searches, all 9 NGO searches, and the one-at-a-time 34-outlet General/Macro Press sweep were run this cycle. No non-Saudi-owned, non-Israeli outlet produced a verified in-window (2026-08-22/23) reputational item. The reputational-risk environment is intense but the specific 24-hour weekend window yielded no verifiable in-window articles from the permitted outlet list.
